gloss: dead end; end of a street

definitions.gloss: dead end; end of a street or corridor
definitions.explanation: the point where a road, hallway, or path ends and you cannot go further in that direction

examples.japanese: {突|つ}き{当|あ}たり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がって→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Turn right at the end of the street.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{突|つ}き{当|あ}たり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The restroom is at the end of this hallway.
If you go to the end, you can see the ocean.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to thrust, poke) + ⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to hit) → hitting a wall/end
⟦{突|つ}き{当|あ}たる→突き当たる：07264_tsukiataru⟧ (to reach the end, to hit)

USAGE:
Commonly used when giving directions. Indicates where a path ends or where one must turn.

ALTERNATE FORM:
{突|つ}き{当|あ}たり (single word)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き{止|ど}まり→行き止まり：08167_ikidomari⟧ (dead end, no through road)
- ⟦{袋小路|ふくろこうじ}→袋小路：09385_fukurokouji⟧ (cul-de-sac, blind alley)
